rationale: dual_domain_n2i-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=24, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=2024, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=12, n_iter=600, outer_wall_s=1700, lr=0.0001, unet_c=16, rationale=iter-16: ONE confirmation knob -> seed 7 -> 2024, at the iter-13/14/15 val_n=24 PEAK basis (val_n=24/ep12/lr1e-4/warm_start=True/n_iter600/grad_clip1.0/unet_c16). This is a 4th-seed averaged CEILING-FINALIZATION read on the WIDER 24-scene basis -- a CONFIRMATION move, NOT a ceiling-raiser (no ceiling-raiser remains for the over-parameterized U-Net on this 128-view synthetic substrate). DIAGNOSIS (numbers, not pixels): the three val_n=24 seed reads landed seed42=0.4616 (iter-13, PSNR 13.45, hr 0.0011), seed123=0.4431 (iter-14, PSNR 14.06, hr 0), seed7=0.4257 (iter-15, hr 0) -> 3-seed mean 0.4435, std 0.0179. That std (0.0179) is NOT tighter than the val_n=12 3-seed std (0.0173, iter-10/11/12), so the iter-15 hypothesis -- that doubling 12->24 scenes would shrink the per-scan std via ~sqrt(2) averaging -- DID NOT FIRE: the per-scan noise floor is INTRINSIC to the per-image N2I objective on this 128-view synthetic substrate, not merely init-set sampling that wider averaging cancels. A 3-sample std is itself poorly determined (only 2 dof), so 'is std ~0.018 the true wider-basis spread, or is the 3-seed mean 0.4435 just a small-sample artifact?' is the one remaining un-pinned quantity in the ceiling documentation. FAILURE MODE = the 0.466 M-param U-Net OVERFITS each single noisy 128-view sparse-phantom scan (the 6-param bilateral twin physically cannot, which is why the twin clears baseline at hr+0.33 while this U-Net stays hr~0 at ~0.43-0.51 SSIM); the per-image fit has an init-driven stochastic noise floor that a wider val basis shrinks but does NOT eliminate (now confirmed: val_n12 std 0.0173 ~ val_n24 std 0.0179). EXHAUSTED / FORBIDDEN axes (do NOT retry, per handoff): n_iter (iter-2 1200 steps 0.4785->0.4293, per-scan overfit), warm_start (iter-8 off -0.0595, load-bearing-positive), lr (iter-3 1e-3->1e-4 + iter-9 1e-4->2e-4 bracket 1e-4 as the per-scan optimum), pretrain_epochs (ep12 peak, ep18 worse 0.5016), unet_c (design-doc warned-against; mayo n2i c16->c32 flat 0.9508), grad_clip=1.0 (LOAD-BEARING 128/2304-view FBP-adjoint overflow guard, mandatory). The ONLY genuinely-untried confirmation knob is a 4TH seed AT the val_n=24 basis. LEVER CHOICE: seed 7 -> 2024 at the val_n=24 PEAK config -- a 4th independent draw turning the 3-seed mean+/-std (0.4435 +/- 0.0179, 2 dof) into a 4-seed mean+/-std (3 dof), tightening the standard error of the wider-basis ceiling estimate by ~sqrt(4/3) and pinning down whether the intrinsic ~0.018 std is real. HYPOTHESIS: seed=2024 at val_n=24 lands inside the [0.42, 0.46] band (the 3-seed mean +/- 1 std), yielding a 4-seed val_n=24 mean ~0.44 with a better-determined std near ~0.018 -- a trustworthy, FINALIZED wider-basis ceiling for the per-image U-Net N2I on this synthetic 128-view substrate. hr stays ~0 (structurally FBP-bounded on dense 128-view phantoms). FALSIFIER: if seed=2024 lands FAR outside [0.42, 0.46] (e.g. <0.40 or >0.48), the per-scan noise floor is WIDER than the 3-seed pair suggested -- and that wide intrinsic floor IS the documented ceiling finding, confirming the over-parameterized U-Net is the wrong tool here vs the bilateral twin (hr+0.33). Either branch FINALIZES the ceiling documentation toward the iter-20 mandate. WALL: warm 12x200=2400 + per-image 24x600=14400 = 16800 steps @ ~0.083 s/step ~= 1394 s; iter-13 ran this exact budget in 1651 s, iter-14 in 1533 s, under the outer_wall_s=1700 guard (per_scene_s = 1700/24 ~= 71 s, ample for 600 steps @ ~0.083 s/step ~= 50 s) and under the 00:30:00 (1800 s) sbatch wall -- the established budget, NOT inflated. All recon-affecting knobs IDENTICAL to the iter-13/14/15 val_n=24 config (train_n=200, val_n=24, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=12, n_iter=600, lr=1e-4, unet_c=16, outer_wall_s=1700); ONLY seed 7 -> 2024 changed.
